newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume surges as prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume surges as prices ease.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange surged to 1,294 kilos on Wednesday, from Tuesday's 610 kilos with an increase of physical demand as prices eased, dealers said.
Gold closed easier at $342.00 an ounce and 1,502,000 lira per gram from $343.60 and 1,511,000 lira previously, following lower levels on European markets.

"We are entering the period when seasonal demand is picking up and the current prices seem low, so there is some physical demand. But there was also a certain amount of registering of gold by the banks," one dealer said.
Banks have to register imported gold on the exchange by buying and selling it themselves before they are able to sell it to non-member traders outside the exchange.
Most of the day's trade -- 1,004 kilos -- took place in the morning session, with 76 percent of the total traded in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
